highlights.en:
The cure is not to remove the doubt but to size the trade so that you
can sleep with it.

He won by
the honesty of saying he had not found it, and by the depth of the
search.
a memorized opening is not a method.

write your ideas down the moment they come,
number them, date them, and keep a copy somewhere safer than a cardboard
box.
a good idea needs a good partner.

a lesson is only learned when you obey it
against your own interest.

check where your material comes from before you
publish it, and get good advice before you pay, not after.

do not judge the future by the size of the
problem; judge it by the method being applied to it.

you find on a chart what you have decided to
look for.

mindmap.note_en: Doubt at night over a large position, and a Kant paper won by honest, deep effort.
mindmap.note_ar: شك ليلي أمام مركز كبير، وبحث كانط الذي كسبه الصدق والعمق.

children.note_en: After a big soybean buy Michael woke wondering if markets were a random walk.
children.note_ar: بعد شراء كبير للصويا استيقظ Michael متسائلًا إن كان السوق random walk.

children.note_en: Do not remove doubt; size the trade so you can sleep with it.
children.note_ar: لا تزل الشك، بل اضبط حجم الصفقة لتنام.

children.note_en: Michael admitted he found no exception to the categorical imperative but showed deep thought.
children.note_ar: اعترف بأنه لم يجد استثناءً لكنه أظهر عمق التفكير.
العمل الجاد أفضل من الأعذار الذكية.

mindmap.note_en: A chess opponent who memorized the Ruy Lopez but did not understand it.
mindmap.note_ar: خصم شطرنج حفظ Ruy Lopez دون أن يفهمها.

children.note_en: He retreated every piece, then lost to checkmate.
children.note_ar: سحب كل القطع ثم خسر بكش مات.

children.note_en: Traders copy patterns without understanding and pull every piece home.

mindmap.note_en: Michael's numbered notebooks were mostly destroyed by a puppy.
mindmap.note_ar: أتلف جرو معظم دفاتر Michael المرقمة.

children.note_en: Over a hundred notebooks, typed out before trading.
children.note_ar: أكثر من مئة دفتر طُبعت قبل التداول.

children.note_en: Write, number, date and back up ideas; a trading journal is the same.
children.note_ar: اكتب ورقّم وأرِّخ واحفظ نسخة؛ ودفتر التداول مثله.

mindmap.note_en: Loyal friend and programmer who built Michael's program in Prolog.
mindmap.note_ar: صديق وفي ومبرمج بنى برنامج Michael بلغة Prolog.

children.note_en: Multiple indicators talking to each other; Jim learned Smalltalk then Prolog.
children.note_ar: مؤشرات تتحدث بعضها مع بعض؛ تعلّم Jim لغتين.

children.note_en: Jim found the same hole in a broker's algorithm three times.
children.note_ar: وجد Jim الثغرة ذاتها ثلاث مرات.

children.note_en: A good idea needs a good partner; loyalty is remembered first.
children.note_ar: الفكرة الجيدة تحتاج شريكًا؛ والوفاء يُذكر أولًا.

mindmap.note_en: The English horn, the borrowed picture, and Go: acting on lessons and methods.
mindmap.note_ar: الـ English horn والصورة المستعارة وGo: العمل بالدروس والطرق.

children.note_en: Michael returned the valuable horn so the widow received $7,000.
A lesson is learned when obeyed against your interest.
children.note_ar: يتعلم المرء الدرس حين يطيعه ضد مصلحته.
كلفت صورة محمية نحو 10 آلاف دولار.

children.note_en: Both checks are cheap compared with skipping them.
Michael predicted computers would beat Go within ten years; AlphaGo did in 2016.
children.note_ar: توقع Michael هزيمة Go خلال عشر سنوات وتحقق ذلك عام 2016.

children.note_en: Judge the future by the method, not the size of the problem.
children.note_ar: احكم على المستقبل بالطريقة لا بحجم المشكلة.

mindmap.note_en: Seeing needs a hypothesis; you find what you decided to look for.
mindmap.note_ar: الرؤية تحتاج فرضية؛ تجد ما قررت البحث عنه.

children.en: They look but do not see
children.note_en: Charlie's line about Peavey gallery traders plus the blue Hondas exercise.
children.note_ar: قول Charlie عن متداولي Peavey وتمرين سيارات Honda.

children.note_en: Decide the setup before opening the screen or a hundred pass unseen.
children.note_ar: حدد الـ setup قبل فتح الشاشة وإلا فاتتك مئة فرصة.
